name: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
summary: Mazu'kon seeks an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City. He wants it for academic study of the Gurubashi's blood magic.

sections.title: Mazu'kon's Request
sections.body: Mazu'kon wants you to search the Drowned City, which lies off the coast of Stranglethorn. The Gurubashi once used pure truesilver idols to channel their blood magic. He hopes to obtain one for his studies, and believes an impressive priest there may have it.

faq.answer: Mazu'kon wants an Ancient Gurubashi Idol for academic study.
The Drowned City lies in the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn.

faq.q: What did the Gurubashi use the idols for?
faq.answer: The Gurubashi used pure truesilver idols to channel blood magic.

faq.q: Why is Mazu'kon seeking an idol?
faq.answer: Mazu'kon wants an idol for academic study.

faq.q: Where might the idol be found?
faq.answer: Mazu'kon believes an impressive-looking priest in the Drowned City may have the idol.
